home.metaTitle: {name} — the tactics board in your browser
home.metaDescription: Draw, animate and share your tactical diagrams from any device, with nothing to install.
home.title: The tactics board that lives in your browser
home.subtitle: Prepare diagrams, animations and training sessions on a computer, tablet or phone. Nothing to install, everything in sync.
home.pitchLabel: Illustration of a football pitch with two teams and movement arrows

editor.title: Full 2D editor
editor.body: Players, equipment, lines and zones, with unlimited undo.

animation.title: Keyframe animation
animation.body: Bring a set piece to life in a few minutes.

sync.title: Instant sync
sync.body: One account on all your devices, no per-machine licence.

share.title: Share by link
share.body: Send an animated diagram to your players, viewable without an account.

sessions.title: Session planning
sessions.body: Combine drills into a session and export a clean PDF.

touch.title: Touch and stylus
touch.body: Usable with a finger on a tablet, even pitch-side.

home.roadmapNote: The 2D editor is available as a demo, no sign-up needed. Online saving and animation are next.
